d.subject: Focus superseded: batch-only -> async continuity effect lifetime
d.head: 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70
d.reason: Peer transfer proved WakeInner generation can expire during normal opening progression, while independent reversal model proved the opposite stale-wake interleaving. Root cause is transition-generation lifetime mismatch, not batching alone.

en: Superseding the batch-only framing: current Alpha3 ties the asynchronous physical inner-wake to controller transition generation, which can expire during normal same-opening progression or remain valid long enough to leak across a reversal. The transferred peer lane has been relinquished; this workstream now owns the combined semantic effect-lifetime investigation.
